changed: Dances you import from The Caller's Box read three more kinds of line as figures instead of text: "N2 Men allemande left 3/4" is the two men allemanding, noted as being with the next neighbors; a hey whose passes name same-role neighbors (SRN) is read as a hey, and "with hands" or a trailing "[with N1]" on a hey is kept as a note instead of leaving the line as text; and "Pass the ocean (to wave of four (NR,WL))" is a pass the ocean into that wave.

The Caller's Box figure dialect reads a neighbour number before a role pair as that pair with a `with` note, decodes `SRN` (same-role neighbours) in hey pass lists and keeps `with hands` and a trailing `[with …]` as the hey's note, and reads a nested wave annotation on pass the ocean.
